summary: Charles & Colvard Ltd. (debtor-in-possession) filed an 8-K disclosing an Asset Purchase Agreement with Van Lang Jewelry LLC / Jewelry Design Partners LLC for $1.5M (subject to credit bid and offset under a DIP loan). The buyer's manager Duc Pham was a former board member. The transaction is a stalking-horse bid under Section 363 of the Bankruptcy Code, requiring Bankruptcy Court approval and subject to higher-or-better bids. A break-up fee may apply, and the deal must close by July 7, 2026. Watch for competing bids and the bankruptcy court's sale hearing.
